title: No, Maria Paseka didn't quit at the Olympics
subtitle: A viral clip from 2012 is missing some very important context
tldr: A widely-shared YouTube Shorts clip claims Maria Paseka 'quit' at the 2012 Olympics — but what you're actually seeing is a deliberate team strategy called a 'scratch', and it was entirely intentional.

title: Nadiu edges Cross by 0.034 at WAG Trial 2
subtitle: Sophie Strano leads a tight Level 8 Division 1 field at CYC, while Emma Hale posts the bars score of the competition
tldr: Arianna Nadiu (MAG Academy) won Level 7 by just 0.034 points at WAG Trial 2 and Border Challenge Trial 2, while Sophie Strano (Jets) led L8 Division 1 with 47.332 and Emma Hale posted a 13.033 on bars.

title: Oceania Selections
subtitle: Australia Names Strong Squads for Home Oceania Championships and International Tour
tldr: Australia has announced full men's and women's squads (senior & junior) for the Oceania Championships in Brisbane, plus selected athletes and coaches for upcoming events in Slovenia and China.

title: Three new Uneven Bars skills
subtitle: Three gymnasts debut original Uneven Bars elements in Osijek, each earning official recognition in the Code of Points
tldr: At the Osijek World Cup, Hamelin (FRA), Mesiri (GRE), and Rodrigues Barbosa (BRA) each successfully performed new Uneven Bars skills, meeting the criteria to have them officially named and added to the Code of Points.
